areas.question: How do guests reach a shared calendar?
areas.why: It decides whether a guest needs an account.

recommendation.reason: No account, and each link can be revoked

alternatives.title: Signed link
alternatives.description: A link signed for one calendar and one guest, sent with the existing invitation email.
cons: A forwarded link reaches whoever receives it

alternatives.title: Guest account
alternatives.description: A light account for each guest.

alternatives.title: Organisation allow-list
alternatives.description: Guests are listed by email domain.

areas.question: What can a guest see of each event?
areas.why: It decides what leaks to a guest.

alternatives.title: Free and busy only
alternatives.description: Blocks of busy time with no titles.
cons: A guest cannot tell which meeting could move
alternatives.key_con: No sense of what could move
